contributions.detail: ⚠ THE FLAGGED DeBRY BASIS TRAP IS PRESENT ON THIS FILING, AND IT RUNS ONE LEVEL DEEPER THAN ON HIS 2015-2018 FILINGS. Tested at the page, column by column: Schedule A (p3) prints SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE = $7,350.00 and TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages) = $72,243.50. The $72,243.50 cell equals Summary line 1 COLUMN B exactly (cycle-cumulative) - a DIFFERENT SCOPE, never an anchor for these rows. But on THIS filing Summary line 1 COLUMN A does NOT hold the period figure either: it reads $64,893.50, which is the PRIOR cumulative (it is byte-for-byte the schedule grand total of his 2018 year-end filing, chunk_13), and 72,243.50 - 64,893.50 = 7,350.00 exactly. The period figure is printed at Summary line 4 (Total Contributions Received, From Line 1 Column A) = $7,350.00, and that is the figure the page subtotal matches. The 7 transcribed rows sum to 7,350.00 = printed page subtotal = Summary line 4, so the side is EXACT. Anchoring on the schedule grand total would have manufactured a $64,893.50 delta; anchoring on Summary line 1 Column A would have manufactured a $57,543.50 one. The schedule's grand-total cell ($72,243.50) is recorded verbatim in totals.total_contributions_to_date and in page_subtotal_gates rather than in schedule_total, because on this filing it is a Column-B-scope figure and the screen would otherwise adopt it as the anchor.

expenditures.detail: Same inversion on Schedule B and verified the same way. p4 prints SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE = $80.00 and TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages) = $25,627.16; the latter equals Summary line 2 COLUMN B (cycle-cumulative). Summary line 2 COLUMN A reads $25,547.16 = the PRIOR cumulative (25,627.16 - 25,547.16 = 80.00), so it is not the period figure either. The period figure is Summary line 6 = $80.00. The 3 transcribed rows (18.00 + 22.00 + 40.00) sum to 80.00 = printed page subtotal = Summary line 6. EXACT. Gating on the schedule grand total would have fabricated a $25,547.16 delta.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 rows 350.00+50.00+250.00+100.00+400.00+200.00+6,000.00 = 7,350.00 = printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE $7,350.00 (EXACT). p4 rows 18.00+22.00+40.00 = 80.00 = printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE $80.00 (EXACT). Both pages ALSO print a grand-total cell - $72,243.50 on p3 and $25,627.16 on p4 - and BOTH were tested against the Summary columns first, found to equal Column B (cycle-cumulative), and deliberately NOT used as gates.
